senses.gloss: उभ उभ (for original अम्भ = ἅμϕω; Lat. ambo; Goth. bai), numeral, m. f. n. dual. Both, Man. 2, 14.
उभय उभ + य, numeral, m. f. n. without dual. Both, Man. 2, 55.

उभयतस् उभय + तस्, adv.
 1. On [] both sides, Man. 8, 315.
 2. In the one and the other case, Man. 1, 47.
उभयत्र उभय + त्र, adv. In both instances, Man. 3, 125.
उभयथा उभय + था, adv. In both cases, Prab. 77, 3; Vikr. 43, 17 (on both reasons).
उभय- + वेतन उभय- + वेतन, adj. 1. accepting wages from his master and his master's enemy, Pañc. 22, 10. 2. living in two elements (water and land), Hit. 88, 17.
